# costgraph_azure_integration (Resource)

Connect an existing Azure FOCUS billing export through a service principal. Requires an organization owner's user API key with organization:manage and a CostGraph deployment with the Azure management APIs. CostGraph verifies export access before saving. Azure storage, the export, principal, and read permissions must already exist. Secrets are write-only and rotate through secret_version. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Import supports directly owned service-principal connections identified by their storage account. Destroy disconnects collection and removes the connection's data from CostGraph cost views. It does not delete Azure resources or revoke the principal's secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "azure_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
  default   = null
}

resource "costgraph_azure_integration" "production" {
  tenant_id        = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  display_name     = "Production Azure"
  azure_tenant_id  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  client_id        = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
  client_secret_wo = var.azure_client_secret
  secret_version   = 1
  storage_account  = "examplebilling"
  container        = "focus-exports"
  export_name      = "costgraph-focus"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `azure_tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra directory UUID, distinct from the CostGraph tenant_id. Changing it requires a new client_secret_wo and a higher secret_version.
- `client_id` (String) Application UUID of the service principal reading the export. Changing it requires a new client_secret_wo and a higher secret_version.
- `container` (String) Existing blob container containing the FOCUS export.
- `storage_account` (String) Existing Azure storage account containing the export. It identifies the connection. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lowercase UUID of the tenant that receives the billing data. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Service principal secret used only on create or explicit rotation. Supply it through an ephemeral input variable. Terraform and OpenTofu do not store it in plan or state. Changing the secret alone does not rotate it. Increase secret_version to use a replacement secret.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in CostGraph. Defaults to the storage account name. Omitting it after creation preserves the stored name.
- `enable_recommendations` (Boolean) Allow CostGraph to collect the provider's savings recommendations. Defaults to true. The cloud identity needs the corresponding read permissions.
- `export_name` (String) Export folder. Defaults to an empty value, which reads the whole container. Omission preserves the stored value. Set an empty string to clear the folder selection.
- `secret_version` (Number) Nonsecret rotation counter stored by CostGraph. Defaults to 1 on creation. Increase it and supply client_secret_wo to rotate. Legacy dashboard connections import with 0 until rotated. Omission preserves the current counter.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection identifier. Use id for import.
- `id` (String) Connection UUID used for management and import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costgraph_azure_integration.production 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004
```
